question: What owns table topology, cell coordinates, selection, clipboard and layout?
trigger: The owner asked for a best-api-review audit of every open ledger unit, judged afresh because earlier verdicts came from a weaker model, then widened it on 2026-10-04 to every existing ledger item. It asked for verdicts only, so no plan, build or panel follows in this run. This scope was closed, with a latest stop verdict, at queue position 17. It is not the unit next returned, which was reads.
requirements: Merged-cell topology, coordinates and spans are table domain law owned by Plate, not Plite.
Cell selection uses a canonical Plite selection and survives copy, cut, paste, undo and multi-view rendering.
Selection paint touches only affected canonical cell hosts per mounted view, with no cell rerender, no public hook, store or generic channel (VISION.md Boundary Law).
Persisted layout lives in table.columnWidths, row height and marginLeft; previews never write the document.
Clipboard egress writes a rectangular slice plus CSV/TSV; structural paste expands only under plugin policy.
Copied registry UI owns toolbars, resize preview, styling and the selection marker style.
evidenceReuse: Reused the 2026-09-17 owner-cohort benchmark, 14/14 Chromium native cases and the 2026-09-18 Strict Mode and edge-paste executions, plus the 2026-09-30 content-root closure. Rechecked on the live tree: BaseTablePlugin read/update/api shape, readMiddleware and commands, React TablePlugin, the private host binder, useTableResize, copied table.tsx consumers, and VISION.md/plate.md text. BaseTablePlugin.ts and grid.ts carry another session's uncommitted markdown-table encode/decode changes (merged cells written as empty slots); they touch format mappings only and decide nothing here.
summary: The job is merged-cell table topology, cell coordinates, rectangular cell selection, clipboard and column and row layout, with selection paint that does not rerender cells. Live BaseTablePlugin owns the grid, 21 read, update and api methods, slice read middleware and insertData and select command interception, and it selects cells through Plite's native node selection (createTableNodeSelection). React TablePlugin binds one private per-view projection to canonical cell hosts through inject.nodeProps ref composition and a root slot effect. useTableResize owns the pointer lifecycle while copied table.tsx owns previews, toolbars and styling. VISION.md and docs/vision/plate.md now codify this exact binder pattern as doctrine, so the previous Stop's design has become law rather than a local exception. The strongest alternatives (a Plite CellSelection API, Plite NodeSelection markers, render.useViewElementAttributes delivery, a public scalar channel, moving resize into copied UI) either duplicate an adequate Plite API, cannot express span closure, or failed the 2026-09-17 owner cohorts. The remaining items are P3, since setBorders and setColumnWidth have no production caller and transformProps reaches the host ref through an untyped cast.

alternatives: Keeping the current design wins, with one Plate owner for semantics, Plite node selection for canonical cell selection and one private binder for paint, all benchmarked and now codified in Vision.
Adding a Plite CellSelection or table-aware selection type is Stop. Plite already carries multi-node selection, and table span closure is Plate product law that would pollute Plite.
Paint through generic Plite NodeSelection markers or render.useViewElementAttributes: Stop; markers cannot express span-closed range paint and the attribute channel lost the 2026-09-17 owner cohorts.
Restore a public useTableSelectionDOM hook or copied overlay context: Stop; it reintroduces caller-assembled paint machinery that was deleted with proof.

Move resize lifecycle into copied UI and delete useTableResize: Stop; pointer capture, cancellation, read-only and replacement cleanup are reusable DOM lifecycle that the package should own, while previews already stay in copied UI.
Cutting the unused update methods (setBorders, setColumnWidth) is a P3 trim of public names with no caller, and it does not reopen ownership.
proofLimits: Source inspection only; no test, browser, Strict Mode or benchmark rerun. Performance and native claims rest on the 2026-09-17/18 records, bound to older source fingerprints. BaseTablePlugin.ts and internal/grid.ts have uncommitted staged changes from another session (markdown merged-cell encoding), not judged here. Physical-device and assistive-technology behavior unverified.
